name: Foundry
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install Foundry Dedicated Server and run it. ATTENTION: First Startup can take very long since it downloads the gameserver files! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available. You can also run multiple servers with only one SteamCMD directory!

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.description: The GAME_ID that the container downloads at startup (2915550 for Foundry Dedicated Server).

variables.name: GAME_PARAMS
variables.description: Enter your extra start up commands for the server here otherwise leave empty.

variables.name: Validate Installation
variables.description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

variables.name: Map Seed
variables.description: Map seed used to generate the world (leave blank for random seed).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Server Password (leave blank for no password)

variables.name: Public Server
variables.description: List Server as Public (set to '0' to disable or set to '1' to enable).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server (default 4).

variables.name: Pause When Empty
variables.description: Pause the server when no players are connected (set to 'true' or 'false').

variables.name: Steam-Username
variables.description: Your Steam username goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: Steam-Password
variables.description: Your Steam password goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: GAME_PORT
variables.description: Game Port - must match the UDP Game Port mapping above.

variables.name: QUERY_PORT
variables.description: Query Port - must match the UDP Query Port mapping above.

variables.name: UID
variables.description: Only change if you know what you are doing!

variables.name: GID
variables.description: Only change if you know what you are doing!
